brief.title: BIEK Computer Science 12th Class Past Paper Analysis (2015–2025)
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive trend analysis of question types, frequency patterns, and topic distribution across 11 years of BIEK Computer Science HSC Part-2 examination papers.
brief.goal: Enable educators, curriculum planners, and students to understand how the BIEK Computer Science exam has evolved over time — identifying shifts in question type distribution, high-frequency years, and patterns that can inform exam preparation strategies and curriculum alignment.

required_sections.title: Dataset & Examination Overview
required_sections.objective: Summarize the scope of the dataset including total questions, year range, and question type breakdown.

required_sections.title: Year-by-Year Question Volume Analysis
required_sections.objective: Analyze how the total number of questions and the mix of question types have changed from 2015 to 2025, identifying any notable increases, decreases, or anomalies.

required_sections.title: Question Type Composition & Trends
required_sections.objective: Break down the proportion of MCQs, Short Questions, and Long Questions across years and assess whether the exam structure has remained stable or shifted over time.

required_sections.title: Recurring Topics & Question Content Patterns
required_sections.objective: Perform a text-level analysis of the question column to identify frequently recurring keywords, topics, or concepts across years and question types.

required_sections.title: Strategic Insights for Exam Preparation
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for students and teachers regarding which question types and topics to prioritize based on historical patterns.

required_sections.title: Conclusions & Limitations
required_sections.objective: Summarize key findings and note any data limitations such as missing years, supplementary vs. annual paper distinctions, or encoding considerations.

kpis.name: Total Questions per Year
kpis.description: The count of all questions (MCQs, Short, Long) appearing in each examination year.

kpis.name: Question Type Ratio
kpis.description: The percentage share of MCQs, Short Questions, and Long Questions relative to the total for each year and overall.

kpis.name: Year-over-Year Change
kpis.description: The absolute and percentage change in total question count from one year to the next.

kpis.name: Average Questions per Type
kpis.description: The mean number of questions per type across all years, serving as a baseline for identifying outlier years.
